title: Bound the search verb's work and stop one long search from blocking every later call in its MCP server
outcome: Bound the search verb's work and stop one long search from blocking every later call in its MCP server
acceptance: A measured reproduction on a throwaway store under target/, sized like the live project's note and gate history, shows search's current cost and where it goes (scan versus mutex wait)
search completes within a documented bound on that reproduction, or refuses with a clear budget-exhausted error instead of running unbounded
While a search runs, other verbs in the same MCP server are not serialized behind it for the duration of the scan, shown by a concurrent-call test
Search results and ordering for existing tests are unchanged
